title: Sound item effect outcome
description: Plays a sound in the world using the given parameters

sound.$comment: A resource location referencing a sound (haven't found a list of all sounds, but you can use the /playsound command to explore what's available).

position.$comment: The position in the world where the sound should be played.

volume.$comment: The volume of the sound. 1.0 is full volume, 0.0 is silent. Defaults to 1.0.

pitch.$comment: The pitch of the sound. 1.0 is normal pitch, 2.0 is double pitch, 0.5 is half pitch. Defaults to 1.0.
